WHAT_THIS_IS: one row per REFUSAL SITE on the build and valuation paths, at the pinned digest, with the condition, the inputs it reads, the rehearsal that exercises it, and whether it HAS been exercised. The user's 'check the issues first', made checkable.
THE_PREDICATE_IS_COMPUTED_NOT_PROSE: a real run is ALLOWED only when EVERY ROW IT CAN HIT is exercised. `da_population_freeze_verify.py --guard-gate <lane>` computes it and REFUSES GUARD_ROW_NOT_EXERCISED_BEFORE_A_REAL_RUN, naming each unexercised site.
SOURCE_OF_THE_ROWS: enumerated BY THE OPERATION -- every `raise` whose message carries a REFUSED <NAME>, parsed from the AST at the pinned digest. DE 303(2) and BE 164(1) had not landed row artifacts when this was built, so these are MINE and must be reconciled with theirs, not assumed to agree.

A_GAP_THIS_ENUMERATION_EXPOSED.WHAT: the BOOK BUILDER IS NOT IN THE POPULATION FREEZE AT ALL
A_GAP_THIS_ENUMERATION_EXPOSED.the_freeze_BUILD_PATH_role_is: the TEN be_cascade modules -- the NULL-RUN path, not the book builder
A_GAP_THIS_ENUMERATION_EXPOSED.consequence: 22 of these refusal sites sit on code the freeze does not pin. A guard register over the build path is only as good as the pin under it, and there is none.

the_exercise_instrument.ITS_DECLARED_LIMIT: TEXTUAL PREDICATE. A cell that drives a refusal WITHOUT NAMING it reads as never-exercised, so THE ERROR INFLATES RATHER THAN DEFLATES. This is a FLOOR on what has been SEEN to be driven, never an exact defect count.
